name: Releasing at the Blackwing Lair portal in Blackrock Spire revives the player at the front door
contract: Blackrock Spire (map 229) is entered from Blackrock Mountain through areatrigger 1468, which lands at 78.5083,
-225.044 (Map.dbc entrance on map 0). Areatrigger 3728 also targets map 229, but it is the exit from inside
Blackwing Lair and lands at the BWL portal (174.74, -474.77). Upper Blackrock Spire (LFGDungeons 44) has no
Dungeon Finder start, so its start is the map's entrance trigger. A player who dies at the BWL portal and
releases is revived at the front door, about 270 yards away, and not at the BWL portal again.
